submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE independent native HD>=1024 square RGBA transparent game-animation frame. Image1 is the edit target: retain exact head/hair, torso, both arms sleeves hands weapons and canvas scale/position. Redraw ONLY legs and adjoining skirt fabric. Image2 is same-character leg anatomy reference. Image3 is approved grounding anatomy only, never copy its identity, bow, clothes. Image4 identity; image5 approved painted style. DIRECTION N pure rear view running away. Anatomical RIGHT hand sword must remain on screen-right, LEFT hand blue rectangular talisman on screen-left. Exactly two connected legs, short original limb proportions. Frame06 of16: RIGHT screen-right foot remains planted as BODY PASSES farther, stage3 pair B. The old image1 WRONG left support must be replaced with image2 RIGHT support. Right calf extends gently rearward from knee to grounded boot; right heel stays down, boot just farther behind than frame05 near94% canvas. LEFT knee advances forward while left ankle is lifted and foreshortened behind skirt, visibly airborne. Distinct from05: left knee more advanced and right hip extends. Keep original short limb length. Same support foot must stay loaded on the world ground for 8 frames, with four progressive fore-aft ground positions, two independent poses per position. In rear view ground depth changes projected shoe height; never force all shoe-bottoms to a horizontal line. Keep feet axes straight NORTH, no outward toe yaw. Natural bent knees and meaningful weight; no standing mannequin, no extra limbs, no whole-character translation or scale change. Never move head or arms to compensate. Genuine transparent alpha; no shadow, guide, text, contact line or background.
